title: Array Derangements (Subhat)

monster.name: Derangement Lich
monster.title: Inverter of Natural Order
monster.defeatQuote: No element stayed in its original position in any derangement!

description: A derangement of `[1, 2, ..., n]` is a permutation `P` where no element appears in its original position (i.e., `P[i] != i + 1` for all `i`). Return all derangements of length `n` in sorted order.
solutionCode:
def generateDerangements(n: int) -> list[list[int]]:
    nums = list(range(1, n + 1))
    res = []
    used = [False] * n
    def backtrack(pos, curr):
        if pos == n:
            res.append(list(curr))
            return
        for i in range(n):
            if not used[i] and nums[i] != pos + 1:
                used[i] = True
                curr.append(nums[i])
                backtrack(pos + 1, curr)
                curr.pop()
                used[i] = False
    backtrack(0, [])
    return res
